candidatos.titulo: ☕ Foto profissional estilo editorial de cafeteria
candidatos.prompt:
Create an ultra-realistic, photorealistic lifestyle portrait of a woman enjoying a relaxing afternoon at an outdoor café. She is seated at a small dark café table, leaning slightly forward with a cheerful, spontaneous expression, laughing naturally with her mouth slightly open. She wears stylish black cat-eye sunglasses with dark tinted lenses and gently touches the frame near her right temple with one hand. Her hair is naturally styled, with a few natural flyaway strands illuminated by sunlight.

Outfit: A relaxed, oversized light beige linen button-down shirt with rolled-up sleeves, naturally draped fabric, and subtle wrinkles, paired with dark denim jeans.

Pose & Expression: Seated comfortably with her upper body leaning slightly forward, one arm resting on the table and the other hand adjusting her sunglasses. Her head is turned slightly toward the camera, with a wide, genuine smile and a joyful, carefree expression.

Foreground Details: A freshly baked golden-brown croissant placed on a white ceramic plate on the left side of the table, alongside a tall transparent glass filled with iced coffee, visible ice cubes, creamy milk and a white straw.

Background: A charming outdoor European-style café setting with blurred tables, chairs, greenery, leafy trees and subtle architectural elements. Softly blurred warm café lights create a beautiful atmosphere.

Lighting: Strong natural afternoon sunlight filtering through the trees, creating beautiful dappled highlights across her hair, face, shoulders and table. Delicate golden rim lighting around her hair, with a balanced combination of warm sunlight and soft natural shadows.

Camera & Composition: Vertical 4:5 composition, medium close-up lifestyle portrait, eye-level camera angle, subject positioned slightly to the right of the frame, with the coffee and croissant clearly visible in the foreground. Shallow depth of field with creamy cinematic bokeh.

Technical Details: Shot on an 85mm portrait lens at f/1.8, natural skin texture, realistic facial details, crisp focus on the woman, beautiful background separation, warm cinematic color grading, subtle film grain, high dynamic range, professional editorial lifestyle photography, ultra-detailed 8K quality.

candidatos.titulo: 🌇 Crie um retrato cinematográfico seu no canal
candidatos.prompt:
Create an ultra-realistic, photorealistic cinematic lifestyle portrait of a handsome man sitting beside a peaceful riverside canal during golden hour.

Subject & Identity: Use the provided reference photo as the exact identity reference. Preserve the person's facial features, face shape, skin tone, and natural proportions with accurate identity matching.

Outfit & Styling: He is wearing a soft ivory-white oversized knit sweater layered over a light blue collared shirt, paired with relaxed-fit black trousers, black shoes. A brown leather crossbody messenger bag with a vintage finish rests against his right hip.

Pose & Composition: The man is seated sideways on a sloping concrete embankment beside the canal, with one knee bent upward and the other leg extended naturally toward the foreground. One arm rests casually over his raised knee, while the other hand rests near his lap. His body faces slightly toward the camera while his head turns toward the left, gazing thoughtfully into the distance. Capture a relaxed, candid, contemplative moment.

Hairstyle & Expression: Naturally styled, slightly tousled hair with a calm, subtle and thoughtful facial expression.

Background & Environment: A quiet Japanese suburban riverside setting featuring a gently flowing canal, lush green grass and wild plants along both banks, a dark steel railway bridge crossing the river in the middle distance, traditional suburban houses, utility poles and overhead power lines. A distant cyclist adds a subtle everyday-life element to the scene.

Lighting & Atmosphere: Warm natural golden-hour sunlight coming from the right side, softly illuminating the subject's face, sweater and surrounding grass. A beautiful pale blue-to-warm peach sunset sky creates a peaceful, nostalgic atmosphere with soft shadows and natural reflections on the water.

Camera & Photography: Vertical 4:5 composition, eye-level camera angle, full-body wide environmental portrait, subject positioned slightly right of center, full seated pose visible, natural perspective, 35mm lens, f/2.8, realistic depth of field, beautifully balanced foreground and background.

Image Quality: Ultra-photorealistic, 8K resolution, highly detailed natural skin texture, realistic fabric knitting, authentic leather texture, cinematic color grading, soft film-like tones, natural contrast, subtle atmospheric depth, professional lifestyle photography.

candidatos.prompt:
Ultra-realistic luxury fashion editorial photograph of the woman in the reference image.

Keep her hair as in the reference, styled in loose, flowing waves, swept back from her forehead and cascading over her right shoulder. Natural luminous skin with visible pores, delicate microtexture, subtle peach blush and minimal elegant makeup.

She wears a luxurious oversized black-and-white zebra-patterned robe dress made of soft, thick, textured fabric. Medium-close portrait, photographed from a slightly elevated frontal angle. Soft natural daylight from the left, warm neutral tones, delicate shadows, realistic fabric texture and subtle highlights on her face and hair, matching the reference.

Minimalist beige interior, understated luxury atmosphere, intimate high-fashion editorial photography, natural skin texture without excessive retouching, realistic hair strands, subtle analog film grain, refined cinematic composition.
